content.title: Coachella 2026 last-minute tickets are still available! get yours now
content.text: April 9, 2026, 12:25 p.m. ETThe 2026 Coachella Music Festival will take place over two weekends in April in Indio, California.Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G are the main headliners for this year's festival.Limited last-minute tickets are still available, with the cheapest starting at $860.The 2026 Coachella Music Festival is almost here and there are still last-minute tickets available.The festival will be held over two weekends in April at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, Calif. Coachella 2026 will run from April 10-12 for the first weekend and April 17-19 for the second.This year's main headliners include Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G.Here's everything you need to know about how to score last-minute tickets to Coachella 2026.Get last-minute Coachella tickets nowHow to buy last-minute Coachella ticketsAs of publication, there are limited last-minute tickets still available for each date of the music festival.Shop Coachella 2026 ticketsSee all available tickets for Coachella now; plus get camping and shuttle passes. Shop Coachella tickets nowFriday, April 10 & 17: Get last-minute tickets nowSaturday, April 11 & 18: Get last-minute tickets nowSunday, April 12 & 19: Get last-minute tickets nowHow much are Coachella tickets 2026?The cheapest available Coachella 2026 tickets right now start at $860 on Sunday, April 12.When is Coachella 2026?Coachella 2026 will take place over two weeks in April at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, Calif. The first weekend is scheduled from April 10-12 and the second weekend is set for April 17-19.When does Sabrina Carpenter perform at Coachella?Sabrina Carpenter will headline on the main Coachella stage on Friday, April 10, and Friday, April 17.When does Justin Bieber perform at Coachella?Justin Bieber is set to perform on Saturday, April 11 and Saturday, April 18. He will headline the main Coachella stage.When does Karol G perform at Coachella?Karol G will make history as the first Latina artist to headline the festival.
